title: Emit human-readable domain label on review findings
summary: Review findings now include a human-readable domain label owned by BCQuality, eliminating the need for consumer taxonomy maps and allowing new review domains to render correctly without engine changes.
key_points: Adds optional `findings[].domain` field to review output schema with display labels like 'Breaking Changes', 'Performance', 'Security'
Each AL review leaf skill sets domain on every finding it emits; cross-cutting findings use 'Agent' as domain
Domain is display text that consumers must preserve exactly without modification or lossy transformation
Backward compatible: absent domain field triggers legacy fallback behavior in consumers
Decouples review domain taxonomy from consumer engine, shifting ownership to BCQuality producers
quote: Every active AL review leaf sets `domain` on every finding it emits, including leaf-level agent findings.
